question: Kanaka Raju has been awarded Padma Shri in 2021 for which of the following folk dances?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gussadi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Kanaka Raju **was** awarded the Padma Shri in 2021** for his contributions to Gussadi

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The Gusadi Dance of Gonds Deepavali is the biggest festival for the Raj Gonds of Adilabad district in Telangana.
 
• Gonds **dressed in colourful costumes** and decorated with ornaments go to neighbouring villages in troupes, singing, and dancing.
 
• Such troupes are called** Dandari dance troupes**.
 
• Each member puts on a **turban of peacock feathers** and horns of the deer, an artificial beard and moustache goatskin to cover the body.
 
• This **starts on the full moon day** and goes on till the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight of Deepavali.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhavai Dance**

 
 
• Bhavai is a **folk dance** form that originates from the Indian state of **Rajasthan.**
 
• In Bhavai, skilled performers (both male and female) showcase their remarkable balancing skills.
 
 
 
• **Fugdi Dance**
 
 
• Fugdi is a **folk dance **performed by the women of certain communities in the Konkan coastal region of **Goa and Maharashtra **
 
• Fugdi involves a group of women dancing in **circles or rows.**
 
 
 
• **Ganagor Dance**
 
 
• **​**Ganagor is a **traditional folk dance** performed during the Gangaur Festival in **rows**.
 
• significant **Rajasthani festival** celebrated by women in honor of **Goddess Parvati** (Gauri).
